mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4, increasing triamcinolone metabolism inhibition and systemic corticosteroid exposure, while triamcinolone may increase infection risk during macrolide therapy.
action: Monitor for enhanced corticosteroid effects (hyperglycemia, immunosuppression, HPA axis suppression); consider alternative antibiotic or dose adjustment of triamcinolone if prolonged clarithromycin use is necessary.
